shortBio.en: Van Halen drummer; double-bass power and ride-bell accents behind Eddie’s riffs.
shortBio.zh: Van Halen 鼓手；双底鼓力度与 ride 钟点衬 Eddie 的 riff。

body.en:
Born 1953. Co-founder with Eddie. Hot for Teacher double-bass and dance-floor pocket on Jump define the kit identity.

Continuous seat through Roth/Hagar swaps; rhythm half of the brothers’ engine.
body.zh:
1953 年生。与 Eddie 共同创办。Hot for Teacher 双底鼓与 Jump 的舞曲律动定义鼓组身份。

跨 Roth/Hagar 换人的连续席位；兄弟引擎的节奏半边。
